title: Diagnose Missing Logs from Source to Search
objectives: Diagnose Missing Logs from Source to Search
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: The three explicit source records exist on hf01 at /var/log/practice/operations.log, but the active monitor points at wrong.log. Trace source file, monitor path, permissions, forwarding destination, target index and actual input checkpoints.

Add the correct native monitor for /var/log/practice/operations.log on hf01 with index=ops_logs and sourcetype=v7_operations, then activate it. Advance one tick and inspect its accepted-byte checkpoint. Search index=ops_logs | stats count and open Job Inspector; expect three records without replaying the file.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
